content: Rifampin significantly reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of tasimelteon by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided. If unavoidable, close monitoring is required. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of tazemetostat through CYP3A4 enzyme induction. Alternative therapies should be considered, as co-administration is not recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of temsirolimus by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. Rifampin lowers the levels or effects of teniposide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Tepotinib increases rifampin levels by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the dosage of P-gp substrates as per product labeling and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases terbinafine levels by inducing CYP1A2 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is recommended. Rifampin reduces tetracycline levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases tezacaftor levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or consider alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces theophylline levels or effects by inducing CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Rifampin decreases thyroid desiccated levels by increasing metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unclear, but close monitoring is advised. Rifampin reduces tiagabine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases tibolone levels by increasing metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unclear, but close monitoring is advised. Rifampin reduces ticagrelor levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with potent CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin decreases tinidazole levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces tipranavir levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of antiviral efficacy loss and viral resistance. Rifampin decreases tivozanib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces tizanidine levels or effects by inducing CYP1A2 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Rifampin decreases tobramycin levels or effects via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces tofacitinib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Loss of therapeutic response may occur. Alternative therapies are recommended. Rifampin decreases tolterodine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces tolvaptan levels or effects via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter and CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or consider alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases toremifene levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing serum concentrations. Alternative therapies are recommended. Rifampin reduces tovorafenib levels by increasing metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP2C8 inducers. Rifampin decreases trabectedin levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces tramadol levels and its active metabolite (O-desmethyltramadol) by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases trandolapril levels by increasing metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unclear, but close monitoring is advised. Rifampin reduces trazodone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or consider alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces triazolam levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases trimethoprim levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces trimipramine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Trofinetide increases rifampin levels by inhibiting OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 transporters. Avoid co-administration with sensitive substrates. Tucatinib increases rifampin levels via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Rifampin decreases tucatinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases typhoid vaccine live levels by pharmacodynamic antagonism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Rifampin reduces ubrogepant levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases ulipristal levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces upadacitinib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin increases vadadustat levels by inhibiting OAT1/OAT3 transporters. Monitor for rapid hemoglobin increases and adverse reactions. Rifampin decreases valbenazine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin increases valsartan levels by inhibiting OATP1B1 transporters. Monitor closely for increased systemic exposure. Rifampin reduces vandetanib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Rifampin decreases vardenafil levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces velpatasvir levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases vemurafenib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces venetoclax levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A inducers. Rifampin decreases verapamil levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces vilazodone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider increasing the vilazodone dose up to twofold when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inducers for more than 14 days. Rifampin decreases vinblastine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces vincristine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases vincristine liposomal levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces vinorelbine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases vonoprazan levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin reduces vorapaxar levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases voriconazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Rifampin reduces vortioxetine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider increasing the vortioxetine dose when co-administered with strong CYP inducers for more than 14 days. Rifampin decreases voxilaprevir levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Rifampin reduces warfarin levels or effects by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases zaleplon levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces zanubrutinib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin increases intranasal zavegepant levels by inhibiting OATP1B3 transporters. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies. Rifampin decreases zidovudine levels by inducing metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces ziprasidone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases zolpidem levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin reduces zonisamide levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases zuranolone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative therapies.
